items.title: 特斯拉推出 Reality View，用端到端网络生成车辆 360 度跟车视角
items.originalTitle: Okay this is nuts. Tesla's new "Reality View" handily sets a new standard for spatial awareness in vehicles. It fuses all the cameras into a fully generated 360 drone view trailing your car, with the route drawn right in. Feels a lot like GTA 6 in real life, except the camera doesn't follow you when you get out of the car. Could not be more perfectly timed, because two days after Rockstar ships the pinnacle of rendering triangles to simulate reality -- Tesla goes the opposite direction using no game engine whatsoever. The universe really does have a sense of humor! As a bonus it uses less compute than the old way - replacing all the explicit signals and draw calls with one end to end network. Elon says it runs on half of one AI4 TRIP accelerator! Maybe i'm just a 3D reality capture nerd, but I cannot overstate how cool this is. I think Tesla's Phil Duan comes close when he says "we've always wanted the UI to show the world through the eyes of the FSD model. We were just too busy solvin
items.summary: 特斯拉推出名为 Reality View 的新功能，把车上所有摄像头融合成一个完全生成的 360 度无人机视角，跟随车辆并直接画出路线。作者称它不使用任何游戏引擎，用一个端到端网络替代了原有的显式信号和绘制调用，算力消耗比旧方案更低；马斯克称它只占用半个 AI4 TRIP 加速器。特斯拉的 Phil Duan 表示，团队一直希望 UI 能通过 FSD 模型的视角展示世界。

items.title: Lovable、Bolt、Replit 与 Claude Code 怎么选：AI 建应用工具对比与切换时机
items.originalTitle: Which AI app builder should you use? Lovable vs Bolt vs Replit vs Claude Code If you want to build an app with AI, here's which tool to use, and when to switch. There are two kinds: App builders, where you start. They run in your browser: you describe the app in a chat, it builds it, and it's running a minute later. Hosting and the database are built in. Lovable: the easiest; good-looking apps, fast. Free to try with 5 credits a day; every message uses credits. Bolt: same idea. Describe it, it builds it, it hosts it. Free to start with a monthly allowance. Replit: a full coding workspace under the chat. Free to try, but the free app goes offline after 30 days; the full builder is about $20 a month. Coding agents, for when you get serious. They work on the real code, on your own computer. Claude Code: comes with Claude Pro (about $20 a month). It's what I build with. Codex: OpenAI's version, with ChatGPT. On the $20 plan you get it in the app, your terminal and your code editor. Cursor
